findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Fix the 'both deciders route through split_provider_qualifier' AC: scope the `grep -rn '":" in model'` predicate to the two decider files (src/rebar/llm/config.py and src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py) — not all of src/rebar/llm/ — since evals/eval.py:101-102 legitimately and intentionally contains `":" in model` and is not a decider.
evidence: Plan/AC text: "verified by `grep -rn '\":\" in model' src/rebar/llm/` returning no matches"
src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:101: `name = model.split(":", 1)[-1].lower() if ":" in model else model.lower()`
src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:102: `head = model.split(":", 1)[0].lower() if ":" in model else ""`
Parent 03b0 implementation comment: 'evals/eval.py:101-102 is eval-only' — deliberately left unchanged

The two DECIDERS the AC intends (_resolve_target at model_classes.py, infer_provider at config.py) already avoid `":" in model` and route through split_provider_qualifier (verified at model_classes.py:239/251 and config.py:213), so the AC's intent is sound — only the grep command is refuted.
findings.finding: The Acceptance-Criterion verification command `grep -rn '":" in model' src/rebar/llm/` is asserted to return 'no matches', but pre-existing eval-only code in src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py lines 101-102 contains the exact substring `":" in model`, so the grep will return two hits and the AC's stated verification result is false. The parent ticket 03b0's own implementation comment explicitly left evals/eval.py's colon splits alone as intentional ('eval.py:101-102 is eval-only'), so this is not new work — the grep predicate is simply mis-scoped to prove 'both deciders route through split_provider_qualifier'.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria — 'Both deciders still route through the one shared split_provider_qualifier' bullet
scenarios: Executor runs the AC's grep to certify completion and gets two eval.py hits, contradicting the 'no matches' claim; a strict reviewer reads the non-empty grep as an unmet AC and blocks, or the executor edits eval-only code the parent deliberately excluded to force the grep clean.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the verification with `grep -rn '":" in model' src/rebar/llm/config.py src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py returning no matches` (the two decider modules), and keep the positive check that _resolve_target and infer_provider each call split_provider_qualifier.
